facts.fact: Presidential decree 20-05 of 20 January 2020 cites Law 09-04 of 5 August 2009, on rules for preventing and fighting offences linked to information and communication technologies, among the laws it rests on, treating it as standing law (document published 2020-01-20; the decree gives no date of entry into force for the law).
facts.system: Loi n° 09-04 du 5 août 2009 portant règles particulières relatives à la prévention et à la lutte contre les infractions liées aux technologies de l'information et de la communication
